_about: Manuscript data decisions that win over data/raw/Quellendaten.xlsx. 'manifests': a source's IIIF manifest (null removes it; 'replaces' lists wrong URLs that earlier loads may have saved in users' browsers, which the new URL then replaces). 'alignments': default pins for a source (a user's own pins win). Applied by scripts/apply_manifest_overrides.py and analyze_transcriptions.py. 'note' is only for people.
